title: Concept: OS command execution via Start-Process (powershell) — review required
description: In powershell, Start-Process executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (Start-Process with -ArgumentList array) are powershell-specific.
applicability: powershell codebases that launch external processes through Start-Process; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
